question: Six employees Dhiraj, Roshan, Satish, Pawan, Tarun and Niraj are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Satish is sitting to the immediate right of Pawan. Niraj is sitting second to the left of Satish. Tarun is sitting to the immediate left of Niraj. Only Tarun is sitting between Niraj and Roshan. Who is sitting between Satish and Roshan?
solution: Given, Six employees Dhiraj, Roshan, Satish, Pawan, Tarun and Niraj are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Satish is sitting to the immediate right of Pawan. Niraj is sitting second to the left of Satish. Tarun is sitting to the immediate left of Niraj. Only Tarun is sitting between Niraj and Roshan.
